project_type: Expo React Native + React-Native-Web POS/CRM app (single codebase, mobile + web + kiosk screens)
build_system: Expo SDK 51, Metro bundler; module alias `@/` and babel-plugin-module-resolver. Vitest + happy-dom for unit tests (vite CJS deprecation warning on test runs is harmless).
build_command: npm run lint   (tsc --noEmit — full type-check; there is no separate compile step)
test_command: npm test   (vitest run)  — but see verification_instructions: run only the loadable test files
verification_instructions: Full `npm test` shows 3 PRE-EXISTING FAILURES (src/store/__tests__/branchPermissionStore.test.ts, src/store/__tests__/cartVat.test.ts, src/services/sync/SyncService.test.ts) that fail to LOAD because they import 'react-native' directly without mocking it. These are a baseline condition NOT caused by and NOT fixed by this task — ignore them. The green baseline to preserve is: `npx vitest run src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/priceResolver.test.ts` => 19 passed (14 cartAdapter + 5 priceResolver). Run new/affected tests by explicit path, e.g. `npx vitest run src/utils src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/data`. Also run `npm run lint` and confirm no type errors. ANY new test that imports a store (productStore/categoryStore) transitively imports react-native + AsyncStorage via src/store/persistStorage.ts and MUST mock both exactly like src/utils/__tests__/priceResolver.test.ts: `vi.mock('react-native', () => ({ Platform: { OS: 'web' } }));` and `vi.mock('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage', () => ({ default: { getItem: async () => null, setItem: async () => {}, removeItem: async () => {} } }));` (OS:'web' makes persist use localStorage which happy-dom provides).
environment_constraints: Work only inside the worktree d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\vmat — relative paths run from here; the parent d:\pos-mobile is a SEPARATE checkout, do not edit it. Windows/PowerShell shell. Commit locally on the worktree branch; never push.
contribution_requirements: Design-system rules (injected, workspace-level): NO hardcoded color/font/spacing/border-radius/shadow — use Colors.*/Typography.*/Spacing.*/BorderRadius.*/Shadow.* (mobile) or WebColors.* (web). Use @/components/ui components (Button/Input/Card/Alert/Badge/Table) before hand-rolling UI. ALL UI text in Thai (labels, placeholders, errors, empty states). Every screen needs loading + error (<Alert type="error">) + empty ("ไม่มีข้อมูล") states. Touch targets >= 44px (ComponentSize.button.md). No `any`; explicit prop interfaces. Modern-red theme #E23744 is ALREADY in src/constants/colors.ts (PRIMARY) and src/constants/webColors.ts — read tokens, never hardcode.
key_patterns: Store house style = function-API over zustand+persist: see src/store/brandStore.ts (persist name 'pos-brands', seed [...MOCK_BRANDS], exported getBrands/getBrand/addBrand/updateBrand/deleteBrand + getBrandProductCount counting useProductStore products, each mutation logAction('แบรนด์',...), exported useBrandStore hook) and src/store/supplierStore.ts. Cart-line id = `${master.id}_${uom.id}`; NEW variant id = `${master.id}_${uom.id}__${variant.id}` (double underscore). uom ids contain single underscores (u1_1), master ids do not (p1) — deductStock must split on '__' FIRST then left.split('_')[0], never positional slice. resolveCartPrice is pure, scales base price by uom.ratio. findProductByBarcode(barcode, products) searches uom.barcodes. Three divergent inline toCartProduct copies exist (POSSaleScreen line 43, WebPOSScreen line 126, KioskPOSSaleScreen line 35) — POS + Web migrate to the new shared src/utils/cartProduct.ts; kiosk keeps its local copy (variants are out of scope for kiosk). VariantSelector is implemented TWICE (mobile modal mirroring UOMSelector/StaffPopup with Colors/Spacing; web inline modal mirroring the UOM Picker Modal with WebColors) — NOT one shared UI component, matching the existing UOM-selector split.
